references.text: Both verses are part of the same continuous narrative about Tamar and Judah, where 38:11 sets up the drama that is resolved in 38:24.
Ruth 4:12 refers directly to the event in Genesis 38 and confirms Tamar's place in the lineage of the Messiah.
1 Chronicles confirms the outcome of the event in Genesis 38 by listing Tamar as the mother of Perez and Serah.
